note: Hand-written slots that no held .bog serializes with a value type. Every entry is marked doc-only and cites the Tridium guide it comes from; the validator trusts these for slot existence and data kind only. Slots that are actions or topics carry slot_kind instead of a value type and are exempt from kind matching.

control:NumericWritable.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Control Module Guide, NumericWritable: sixteen priority inputs in1..in16 of StatusNumeric; out is StatusNumeric. Every control point carries proxyExt and facets.

control:BooleanWritable.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Control Module Guide, BooleanWritable: sixteen priority inputs in1..in16 of StatusBoolean; out is StatusBoolean. Every control point carries proxyExt and facets.

control:EnumWritable.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Control Module Guide, EnumWritable: sixteen priority inputs in1..in16 of StatusEnum; out is StatusEnum. Every control point carries proxyExt and facets.

control:StringWritable.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Control Module Guide, StringWritable: sixteen priority inputs in1..in16 of StatusString; out is StatusString. Every control point carries proxyExt and facets.

control:TimeTrigger.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Control Module Guide, TimeTrigger: fireTrigger is a Topic fired on the configured schedule.

program:Program.source: Tridium Niagara 4 Program Module Guide: a Program component's frozen slots include the execute Action and the code ProgramCode property; its other slots are declared per instance.
